summary: Malformed candidate payloads can overwrite persisted outputs, and the runbook references runtime signals that do not exist.
head: 216d1dc5e45abdd23c344b7ad1d86570e7797c2d

findings.detail: record_meeting_candidates validates identity fields only; malformed candidate fields are normalized to empty values and can overwrite persisted outputs.
The runbook names metadata and audit keys that are not emitted by the implementation.
